summary: Kanzhun Ltd filed a Form 6-K attaching a Next Day Disclosure Return for the Hong Kong Stock Exchange, reporting changes in issued shares due to employee share scheme exercises (27,784 shares at USD 3.6749 per share from option exercises and 2,250 RSUs at USD 0) and a series of share repurchases for cancellation from March 20 to April 9, 2026, totaling approximately 10.3 million shares at prices ranging from USD 6.58 to USD 6.82. These open-market repurchases reflect an ongoing capital return program. Investors should monitor the pace of future buybacks and potential cancellation effects on share count and EPS.
